messages:
sam: heads-up: customer hit duplicate confirmed tokens when a resumed stream and a background prefetch both charged the same prefix. quick repro attached.
noor: can you paste the minimal logs?
sam: logs:
```
2026-03-22T09:04:12.001Z [router] session=sess1 event=provisional_charge prefix=96 tx=tx-r
2026-03-22T09:04:12.005Z [prefetch] session=sess1 event=provisional_charge prefix=96 tx=tx-p
2026-03-22T09:04:12.010Z [ledger] tx=tx-r event=confirm tokens=96
2026-03-22T09:04:12.012Z [ledger] tx=tx-p event=confirm tokens=96
```
sam: ledger ends up summing both.
ben: sounds like sidecar didn't detect router claim. two distinct tx ids cause double confirm.
anya: cheap mitigation: prefetch check a session-level "claimed_prefixes" map before provisional. if present, skip provisional.
noor: that helps but multi-region races still possible. long-term: make ledger merge confirms by session+range overlap and pick canonical tx (earliest or router-preferred).
billing-bot: billing-alert session=sess1 delta=+96 tokens generated.
ben: console ask: show per-session provisional tx ids and their sources so ops can spot duplicates. current agg hides this.
sam: I'll draft RFC with reproducer, short mitigation (in-memory check + conservative confirmation), and ledger dedupe proposal. aiming for canary next week.
